source: Library of Congress, Sanborn Fire Insurance Map, St. Louis Vol. 12 (1938, revised to 1950), sheet 50, image 04858_12_1950-0050
labeled_by: AI-assisted draft from the 1938 key: each site compared with the 1950 scan side by side, 2026-10-19
scope: Industrial, fuel, tank and vehicle-service uses, plus every G.T. symbol. Excludes dwellings, plain stores and flats, offices, the post office, and private auto houses. Groups (a field of tanks) are one entry.

definitions.gasoline_tank_count: Number of G.T. / G.T.S. symbols drawn for this site. 0 means none drawn.
definitions.map_notes: Only what is printed on the sheet.
definitions.interpretation: Inference, not a map fact; never scored.
definitions.needs_human_check: Fields still to confirm by eye.

sheet_layout: Two strips: left = S Broadway, Dover to Holly Hills (river to the east); right = S Broadway, Holly Hills to Quincy (river at far right). Entries on the right strip are not at the sheet edge.

buildings.label: PAINT'G
CARONDELET MFG. CO. SASH & DOOR FACTY.
buildings.map_notes: Lumber warehouse, lumber storage, dry kiln, glueing room, shavings bin. Fuel: coal & waste. Blowers to woodworking machinery. 19,000 gal wood gravity tank (city water).

buildings.label: COTTONWOOD FIBRE CO. MFG. PLASTER FIBRE
buildings.map_notes: Log yard. Raw stock & sawing. Dust bins. Fuel: gas & wood. Blowers to shredding machinery.

buildings.label: USED AUTO SALES
buildings.map_notes: Coal yard replaced by a used auto lot.
buildings.approved_note: approved in review: street number; construction

buildings.label: THE JOHNSTON TIN FOIL & METAL CO. MFG. METAL FOIL
buildings.map_notes: Smelting furnace & melting pot; 4 melting pots; machine shop. Fuel oil tank (underground). Fuel: coal & oil. Transformer house (TRANSF. HO.): fireproof construction, concrete floor & roof, brick walls. Bldg 4 built 1918, bldg 6 built 1936, one bldg built 1937. 20,000 gal wood gravity tank on steel trestle (water).
buildings.interpretation: Transformer house may be a PCB screening concern; not documented on the map.

buildings.label: COAL YARD
JUNK YARD
buildings.map_notes: Junk yard on the lot behind 6300; small 1-story frame 'JUNK' building at 6304.

buildings.label: MISSISSIPPI VALLEY IRON CO. PIG IRON PLANT (NOT IN OPERATION)
buildings.map_notes: Blast furnace, boilers (dilapidated), stoves 65 ft high, iron tanks, water tower, transformer room, inclined conveyor, ore handling crane. Steel gravity tank elevated 60 ft on steel trestle, 50,000 gal (not used). No power, no lights.
buildings.interpretation: Slag or iron fill along the river is possible but not shown on the map.
buildings.approved_note: approved in review: still on the 1950 map? Pig iron plant pasted over in 1950, but scrap iron and melting buildings remain nearby.

buildings.label: ST. LOUIS STEEL CASTING CO. MFG. STEEL CASTINGS
buildings.map_notes: 2 electric melting pots, brick core oven, 3 iron core ovens, sand, scrap iron, dust collector, transformer room. Fuel: coke & gas.

buildings.label: MATERIALS PACKING & FORWARDING CO. DIV'N OF MARQUETTE CEMENT CO.
buildings.map_notes: Cement elevator, capacity 55,719 bbls. 8 concrete tanks on steel frame, 66-83 ft high; sacking room under tanks; sack storage; iron dust house on roof; office & compressor room; wood platform to dock on the river. Heat: steam in office. Power: electric. Fuel: coal.

buildings.label: BULK OIL STA. / GASOL STGE TKS.
buildings.map_notes: Same lot and common roof as the 6800 filling station, corner of E Kraus. Oil warehouse, office, pump house. 4 gasoline storage tanks. | 1950 G.T. count checked on the full-resolution 1950 scan: 4

buildings.label: CARONDELET ICE MFG. & FUEL CO. ARTIFICIAL ICE PLANT
buildings.map_notes: 2 ammonia tanks; engine room, boiler room, ice storage. Fuel: coal. Alternate numbers (6807), (6815).

buildings.label: CENTRAL VALLEY VINEGAR CO. VINEGAR WKS.
buildings.map_notes: Wooden vinegar vats, iron vinegar vats, iron alcohol tank. Fuel: coal.

buildings.label: SEMI-STEEL CASTING CO. MFG. CASTINGS
buildings.map_notes: Foundry (2 buildings), cupolas, pattern storage, flask storage, rattlers, sand storage, brick oven. 1 G.T. beside building E on E Quincy. | 1950 G.T. count checked on the full-resolution 1950 scan: 0 (1938: 1; the 1950 paste-over shows no tank circles)

buildings.label: FILL'G STA.
buildings.map_notes: BR. TO EAVES; concrete floor. 3 G.T. Corner of E Kraus. Shares a building with the bulk oil station. | 1950 G.T. count checked on the full-resolution 1950 scan: 1

buildings.label: H-H FEED MILLS - HEINRICHMEYER FEED CO.
buildings.map_notes: Feed warehouse, grain bins, elevator built 1912 (capacity 30,000 bu). Continues south of Loughborough at 6900-6902.

buildings.label: FILL'G STA.
buildings.map_notes: Concrete floor. 1 G.T. + 2 G.T.S. Corner of E Quincy. | 1950 G.T. count checked on the full-resolution 1950 scan: 3

buildings.label: FILL'G STA.
buildings.map_notes: Concrete floor. 2 G.T.S. South of E Soper. Missed by the first draft and first audit. | 1950 G.T. count checked on the full-resolution 1950 scan: 2

buildings.label: MATTRESS FACTY.
buildings.approved_note: approved in review: still on the 1950 map? Not located on the crops.

buildings.map_notes: Locomotive house is PATTERN STG. in 1950.

verification.method: AI-assisted draft from the verified 1938 key (each site compared on the 1938 and 1950 scans; 1950 tank counts checked at full resolution), reviewed and approved by Baburaj on 2026-10-21. 4 sites that had been flagged for a check were approved in that review. Not included: businesses new since 1938, so precision against this key reads low.
